caveat: When installed, initialized and configured as specified in Section 3.1 of the Security Policy. When FIPS Kit 550-06508 is installed, initialized and configured as specified in Section 3 of the Security Policy.
description: The SBC 5400 Session Border Controller is a high-performance air-cooled, 2U, IP encryption appliance that provides secure SIP-based communications with robust security, reduced latency, real-time encryption (VOIP signaling and media traffic), media transcoding, flexible SIP session routing, and policy management.
allowed_algorithms: Diffie-Hellman (CVL Certs. #C869 and #C870, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides 112 bits of encryption strength); EC Diffie-Hellman (CVL Certs. #C868, #C869 and #C870, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides between 112 and 256 bits of encryption strength); NDRNG; RSA (key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides 112 bits of encryption strength)
hardware_versions: SBC 5400 with ASPEED AST2400 and FIPS Kit 550-06508
